selected_script.angle: Stop trying to scrub sticky grill-grate grease with crumpled foil because it only drags black oily residue around; foam the same greasy bars with EcoPure Lab Heavy Duty Degreaser, wipe, and show a cleaner metal contrast.
selected_script.hook: I tried scrubbing this greasy grill grate with foil, and it just made black oil smear everywhere.

timeline.0-3s: Extreme close-up of sticky black-brown grease baked onto a grill grate; a hand uses crumpled aluminum foil as a familiar quick scrub method, but the oily residue spreads across the bars instead of lifting.
timeline.3-6s: The same foil scrubbing continues on the same grill-grate section, visibly amplifying black smears on the metal, greasy residue on the foil, extra hand effort, and a small frustrated pause.
timeline.6-10s: EcoPure Lab Heavy Duty Degreaser enters naturally beside the same grate; the white trigger bottle sprays light foam onto the smeared section, a cloth wipes through the loosened grease, and the camera proves the cleaner wiped strip next to the still-greasy area with a light spoken CTA.

scenes.promptText:
Create one complete approximately 10-second vertical TikTok-style UGC cleaning ad in 9:16, realistic handheld phone-shot style in an ordinary American kitchen or patio prep area, no studio polish. Use the provided product reference image as the exact product identity: EcoPure Lab Heavy Duty Degreaser in a white trigger spray bottle with short rectangular white nozzle, ribbed white screw collar, smooth molded white plastic body with side finger grooves, rounded rectangular lower body, glossy orange front label with EcoPure Lab logo near the top, large Heavy Duty Degreaser title, Foaming Action subtitle, small stovetop image panel, and dark navy bottom band with 10.1 fl oz / 300 ml cue. Preserve color, label layout, shape, material, proportions, logo position, and visible structure exactly; do not change it into another cleaner and do not invent accessories or packaging.

Timeline: 0-3s: Start in an extreme close-up, not a product shot. Show sticky black-brown baked-on grease on metal grill-grate bars. A hand uses a familiar ordinary method: crumpled aluminum foil scrubbing the greasy grate. The foil drags through the residue, but the grease does not lift; it spreads into dark oily streaks across the metal. The shot feels like a real phone video, slight handheld shake, natural light, close enough to see the smeared oil texture.

3-6s: Continue the same failed method on the exact same stain and same grate area. The hand scrubs harder with the foil, but the black grease smears wider, leaves residue on the foil, and the bars look cloudier and dirtier. Show realistic effort and a tiny frustrated pause or wrist pullback. Keep the stain credible, messy, and everyday; no exaggerated grime mountain, no comedic effects.

6-10s: The EcoPure Lab Heavy Duty Degreaser bottle enters naturally from the side into the same close-up scene, label briefly readable and facing camera. The hand sprays a light, realistic foaming layer directly onto the same smeared grill-grate section. Let the foam cling and loosen the oily residue without magical instant disappearance or dramatic chemical effects. A plain cleaning cloth wipes through the treated area with one or two firm passes. Finish by tilting slightly to show credible proof: the wiped section of the same grate is visibly cleaner with metal showing, placed beside an untouched greasy section for a natural before-after contrast, not a graphic split screen. End with a light spoken CTA such as, “Try it for the greasy spots you keep putting off.”

Forbid UI, subtitles, stickers, text overlays, watermarks, floating icons, poster headlines, added labels, invented accessories, product drift, magical cleanup, smoke, sparks, bubbling chemical exaggeration, disinfectant or bacteria-killing claims, and any before-after text graphics.
